narrative.overview: Mars is a serious native instrument, and this page is the register it keeps for itself: a civic bureau's prospectus, printed on airy late-modern paper. It refuses both the dark terminal-and-neon hero that every coding tool ships and the equal-card SaaS grid. Instead the ledger is the argument — every capability is one attributed entry with a state and a piece of evidence attached, and the install command is the register's own closing action. The world is light, disciplined and calm, but not beige: a cool near-white ground, deep navy-violet ink, and a single committed violet accent, with one flowing mint to violet to indigo ribbon as the page's only gesture.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground (#f7f7fa) with white plates and hairline keylines; no cream, no glass.
One committed accent, violet (#685ce7), carried by state signs, tokens, links and the action, never by whole sentences.
A register grammar: sections are citizen-facing titles with a left-aligned body and a mono meta column; entries are signed (+ / ~ / -) and dated by release line.
Hanken Grotesk for the voice (display 500, reading 400); Spline Sans Mono only for machine literals.
One ribbon gradient, one halftone skyline; depth from a soft single elevation, never glow.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only chromatic accent on the light ground. Everything else is ink, body, or keyline. Its scarcity is what makes the state signs read.

rules.name: The Small Text Deepens Rule
rules.body: Small violet text (below about 18px) uses Register Violet Deep (#4d43cf), never Register Violet (#685ce7). The brighter violet is for fills and large display only.

rules.name: The Literal Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for what the machine reads or writes: version refs, flags, commands, paths, counts. Narrative prose is always Hanken.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: A section title carries its own weight; there is no small label above a heading to introduce it.

rules.name: The Neutral Elevation Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is neutral near-black, offset, and softly blurred. Shadows never carry the accent color.

rules.name: The Soft-Corner Rule
rules.body: Controls are 8px, plates are 14px, and nothing is a pill. The register is precise, not playful.

dos: Do keep the section ladder in citizen-facing titles and put meta in the mono label voice.
Do set machine literals — versions, flags, commands, paths, counts — in Spline Sans Mono, and narrative in Hanken Grotesk.
Do carry state with the signed-entry device: a colored sign, a version, a state word, an openable exhibit.
Do keep violet as a mark, and deepen it (#4d43cf) for small text.
Do give every interactive target a 44px (2.75rem) minimum height and a visible focus ring.
donts: Don't add an eyebrow or kicker label above a heading.
Don't set whole sentences in violet, and don't use violet for body copy.
Don't use cream, glass, blur, glow, or a colored halo; elevation is neutral and soft.
Don't use monospace as a costume for 'technical' — only for things the machine reads.
Don't rebuild the register as equal cards of icon-plus-heading-plus-text; the signed entry is the unit.
